import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

# --- Data ---
# (model_label, suite, gap_pp, cv)
data = [
    (r'$\pi$0.5',  'Object',  28.8, 0.055),
    (r'$\pi$0.5',  'Spatial', 21.4, 0.055),
    ('X-VLA',       'Object',   0.2, 0.151),
    ('X-VLA',       'Spatial',  1.4, 0.151),
    ('X-VLA',       'Goal',     0.2, 0.151),
    ('OpenVLA',     'Object',   1.4, 0.215),
]

models_order = [r'$\pi$0.5', 'X-VLA', 'OpenVLA']
cv_map = {r'$\pi$0.5': 0.055, 'X-VLA': 0.151, 'OpenVLA': 0.215}

# Colors: pi0.5 = warm/vermillion, others = cool/blue
COLOR_WARM = '#D55E00'
COLOR_COOL = '#0072B2'
COLOR_WARM_EDGE = '#A04500'
COLOR_COOL_EDGE = '#004F7F'

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5.5, 4.125))  # 4:3

# Build bar positions: group by model with gaps between groups
bar_width = 0.6
group_gap = 0.8
positions = []
labels = []
colors = []
edge_colors = []
values = []

x = 0
group_centers = {}
for model in models_order:
    suites = [d for d in data if d[0] == model]
    group_start = x
    for suite_data in suites:
        positions.append(x)
        labels.append(suite_data[1])
        values.append(suite_data[2])
        if model == r'$\pi$0.5':
            colors.append(COLOR_WARM)
            edge_colors.append(COLOR_WARM_EDGE)
        else:
            colors.append(COLOR_COOL)
            edge_colors.append(COLOR_COOL_EDGE)
        x += 1
    group_centers[model] = (group_start + x - 1) / 2
    x += group_gap

bars = ax.bar(positions, values, width=bar_width, color=colors,
              edgecolor=edge_colors, linewidth=0.8, zorder=3)

# Value annotations on bar tops
for pos, val, bar in zip(positions, values, bars):
    ax.text(pos, val + 0.6, f'{val:.1f}', ha='center', va='bottom',
            fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='#333333')

# Method-independent threshold line
ax.axhline(y=2, color='#999999', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.0, zorder=2)
ax.text((positions[1] + positions[2]) / 2, 3.2, 'method-independent\nthreshold (2 pp)',
        fontsize=8, color='#999999', va='bottom', ha='center')

# X-axis: model names with CV below
ax.set_xticks([group_centers[m] for m in models_order])
ax.set_xticklabels([f'{m}\n(CV={cv_map[m]:.3f})' for m in models_order], fontsize=10)

# Suite labels below bars
for pos, label in zip(positions, labels):
    ax.text(pos, -1.8, label, ha='center', va='top', fontsize=8, color='#555555')

# 15x bracket between pi0.5-Spatial (21.4) and X-VLA-Spatial (1.4)
pi05_spatial_pos = positions[1]
xvla_spatial_pos = positions[3]

bracket_y = 23.5
ax.annotate('', xy=(pi05_spatial_pos, bracket_y), xytext=(xvla_spatial_pos, bracket_y),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color='#333333', lw=1.2))
ax.text((pi05_spatial_pos + xvla_spatial_pos) / 2, bracket_y + 0.8,
        r'$15\times$', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=11,
        fontweight='bold', color='#D55E00')

ax.set_ylabel('Method gap |SR(L2) $-$ SR(Random)| (pp)')
ax.set_title(r'Method sensitivity at $k\!=\!0.95$', fontsize=13, pad=10)

ax.set_ylim(-3, 33)
ax.set_xlim(-0.6, positions[-1] + 0.6)

ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.2, zorder=0)

plt.tight_layout()

outdir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-be-idea-gen-0515-2/projects/importance_margin_vla_compress/docs/paper/figures/paper'
plt.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig_method_gap.pdf')
plt.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig_method_gap.png')
print(f'Saved fig_method_gap.pdf and fig_method_gap.png')

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

# --- Data ---
# (model_label, suite, gap_pp, cv)
data = [
    (r'$\pi$0.5',  'Object',  28.8, 0.055),
    (r'$\pi$0.5',  'Spatial', 21.4, 0.055),
    ('X-VLA',       'Object',   0.2, 0.151),
    ('X-VLA',       'Spatial',  1.4, 0.151),
    ('X-VLA',       'Goal',     0.2, 0.151),
]

models_order = [r'$\pi$0.5', 'X-VLA']
cv_map = {r'$\pi$0.5': 0.055, 'X-VLA': 0.151}

# Colors: pi0.5 = warm/vermillion, others = cool/blue
COLOR_WARM = '#D55E00'
COLOR_COOL = '#0072B2'
COLOR_WARM_EDGE = '#A04500'
COLOR_COOL_EDGE = '#004F7F'

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4.5, 4.125))  # narrower with 2 models

# Build bar positions: group by model with gaps between groups
bar_width = 0.6
group_gap = 0.8
positions = []
labels = []
colors = []
edge_colors = []
values = []

x = 0
group_centers = {}
for model in models_order:
    suites = [d for d in data if d[0] == model]
    group_start = x
    for suite_data in suites:
        positions.append(x)
        labels.append(suite_data[1])
        values.append(suite_data[2])
        if model == r'$\pi$0.5':
            colors.append(COLOR_WARM)
            edge_colors.append(COLOR_WARM_EDGE)
        else:
            colors.append(COLOR_COOL)
            edge_colors.append(COLOR_COOL_EDGE)
        x += 1
    group_centers[model] = (group_start + x - 1) / 2
    x += group_gap

bars = ax.bar(positions, values, width=bar_width, color=colors,
              edgecolor=edge_colors, linewidth=0.8, zorder=3)

# Value annotations on bar tops
for pos, val, bar in zip(positions, values, bars):
    ax.text(pos, val + 0.6, f'{val:.1f}', ha='center', va='bottom',
            fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='#333333')

# Method-independent threshold line
ax.axhline(y=2, color='#999999', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.0, zorder=2)
ax.text(positions[-1] + 0.3, 3.2, 'method-independent\nthreshold (2 pp)',
        fontsize=8, color='#999999', va='bottom', ha='right')

# X-axis: model names with CV below
ax.set_xticks([group_centers[m] for m in models_order])
ax.set_xticklabels([f'{m}\n(CV={cv_map[m]:.3f})' for m in models_order], fontsize=10)

# Suite labels below bars
for pos, label in zip(positions, labels):
    ax.text(pos, -1.8, label, ha='center', va='top', fontsize=8, color='#555555')

# 15x bracket between pi0.5-Spatial (21.4) and X-VLA-Spatial (1.4)
pi05_spatial_pos = positions[1]
xvla_spatial_pos = positions[3]

bracket_y = 23.5
ax.annotate('', xy=(pi05_spatial_pos, bracket_y), xytext=(xvla_spatial_pos, bracket_y),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color='#333333', lw=1.2))
ax.text((pi05_spatial_pos + xvla_spatial_pos) / 2, bracket_y + 0.8,
        r'$15\times$', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=11,
        fontweight='bold', color='#D55E00')

ax.set_ylabel('Method gap |SR(L2) $-$ SR(Random)| (pp)')
ax.set_title(r'Method sensitivity at $k\!=\!0.95$', fontsize=13, pad=10)

ax.set_ylim(-3, 33)
ax.set_xlim(-0.6, positions[-1] + 0.6)

ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.2, zorder=0)

plt.tight_layout()

outdir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-be-idea-gen-0515-2/projects/importance_margin_vla_compress/docs/paper/figures/paper'
plt.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig_method_gap.pdf')
plt.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig_method_gap.png')
print(f'Saved fig_method_gap.pdf and fig_method_gap.png')
